LanguageData.LP_Background_Acolyte.degreeDatas.color7:
{PAWN_nameDef} once served in a temple and is used to prayer and contemplation.

- Meditation psyfocus gain +20%
- Mood +3 "sacred time" (1 day) after attending any ideoligion ritual
- With Vanilla Psycasts Expanded: cleric path XP +25%
LanguageData.LP_Background_Criminal.degreeDatas.color:
{PAWN_nameDef} made a living in the shadows of the city; picking locks, fencing goods and dodging guards are old habits.

- As a prisoner: prison break chance ×2
- When the colony has a colonist with the criminal background, prisoner break chance ×0.75 ({PAWN_pronoun} knows where prisoners slip through)
- 10% better prices when trading with Black Network caravans
- As a prisoner, each recruitment talk lowers resistance ×1.3
LanguageData.LP_Background_FolkHero.degreeDatas.color:
{PAWN_nameDef} once stood up against tyrants and monsters, and the folk back home still sing {PAWN_possessive} story.

- While drafted, other colonists within 6 cells get mood +3 "the hero is here"
- When {PAWN_pronoun} is downed, the whole colony gets mood -3 "the hero has fallen" (1 day)
LanguageData.LP_Background_Noble.degreeDatas.color7FB:
{PAWN_nameDef} comes from a noble family, raised to give orders rather than hold a broom.

- Social impact +15%
- Won't do cleaning or hauling
- Mood -4 "beneath my station" when bedroom impressiveness is below "decent"
- With the Royalty DLC: honor gained ×1.2
- Mutually exclusive with ascetic
LanguageData.LP_Background_Sage.degreeDatas.color7FBF:
{PAWN_nameDef} spent most of their life in libraries and academies and feels out of sorts without books.

- Research speed +10%
- Reading benefit +30%
- With Vanilla Psycasts Expanded: wizard path XP +25%
- Mood -2 "nothing to read" when the colony has no bookshelf or research bench
LanguageData.LP_Background_Soldier.degreeDatas.color7:
{PAWN_nameDef} served in the army, and the body moves on its own at a command.

- Aiming time -10% while drafted
- With another ally of the soldier background within 3 cells, both get shooting accuracy and melee hit +5%
LanguageData.LP_Background_Hermit.degreeDatas.color7F:
{PAWN_nameDef} lived as a hermit alone in the wilds for many years and is more used to their own thoughts than to crowds.

- Mood +3 "a place of solitude" with a private bedroom
- Mood -4 "no peace and quiet" when sharing a bedroom (replaces the vanilla "slept in barracks" mood)
- Meditation psyfocus gain +30%
- Frequency of starting social interactions ×0.5
LanguageData.LP_Background_Outlander.degreeDatas.colo:
{PAWN_nameDef} grew up on the wastelands beyond civilization; wind and rain are everyday life to {PAWN_objective}.

- Move speed +10% where there's no roof and outside the home area
- Wild plant harvest yield +25%
- Unaffected by bad weather moods like getting soaked or dust storms
- Mood -3 "cooped up" after staying under a roof for 3 days straight
